theorems.name: Submission.rsd_mw_tfa_smooth_cutoff
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (V : Set (Euclid P)), IsFiniteMeasure ν → IsOpen V → ν Vᶜ = 0 → ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ χ : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) χ ∧ HasCompactSupport χ ∧ tsupport χ ⊆ V ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ χ x ∧ χ x ≤ 1) ∧ ν {x | χ x ≠ 1} < ENNReal.ofReal δ
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
